title: Fleet Management in the Americas Industry Report 2024 - Hardwired, Mobile and Hybrid Telematics Systems to Co-exist
description: The report forecasts healthy growth in the fleet management market in North and Latin America, with the number of systems in use expected to increase significantly by 2028. It also highlights the leading providers of aftermarket fleet management solutions and the increasing involvement of commercial vehicle OEMs in the industry.

title: Telematics for Rental and Leasing Fleets Report, 3rd Edition: Geotab, Targa Telematics, OCTO Telematics, CalAmp, Webfleet, Powerfleet, Munic, MySmartObject, Connected Cars and RentalMatics Dominate
description: The report provides insights into the growing adoption of telematics solutions by car rental and leasing companies in Europe and North America, driven by trends like connected cars, new mobility services, and vehicle electrification. It profiles leading telematics providers and rental/leasing companies in the industry.
